pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "MailerLite renamed Growing Business to Comfort and Advanced to Power in June 2026, and raised paid prices by roughly 10 to 30 percent across every subscriber tier… Free Plan: 250 subscribers and 2,500 monthly emails… Comfort… Starts at $10/month for 500 subscribers… Power… Starts at $20/month for 500 subscribers"
